payload.transcript: Hello? Good evening, Mr Raghav. Good evening. Meera speaking. This is a cold introduction, and I'd like about forty seconds to explain why I'm calling. What is it regarding? I'm from SpendNest. We help companies bring fragmented expense and payables processes together: supplier records, invoice processing, local expenses, advances and reimbursements. Cards and instant payments can have spending limits, so the company can see what each fulfilment location or manager is spending. The same system can hold documents, schedule payments and route approvals, leaving a record of the activity. Is this an enterprise management system? We position it alongside one. Your existing system may handle accounts, records and approvals; we provide payment execution and related records, with connections back to that system. All right, I understand. Let me give you an email address. Could you send a proposal there? Absolutely. The colleague handling our people operations also deals with frontline processes and the locations. I think we may have been looking at a solution, but I don't know the details. There have been some discussions. If you send him a proposal and say you spoke with me, he can take a look. Certainly. Let me write the address down. It's contact08@example.com. Could you repeat that? contact08@example.com. Let me read it back to make sure I have the right address: contact08@example.com? Yes, that's correct. Okay, I'll send the information there. Hopefully there is something useful to explore. Fine, thank you. Thank you for your time. Have a good evening. Goodbye.
